raw:
@q query
  mode count
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "work at"
      role subject ?x
      role object "Orion Robotics"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be old"
      role subject ?x
      role object ?age
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  compare ?age above 40
